Welcome to Government Polytechnic College, Ranipur

Government Polytechnic College, Ranipur was established in 1968 and offers three year diploma programmes in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering and Computer Engineering.

The college is affiliated to the State Board of Technical Education and approved by the All India Council for Technical Education.

Our campus spans twelve acres and includes fully equipped workshops, a central library, a computer centre and hostel facilities for both boys and girls.

Principal's Message

It gives me great pleasure to welcome students, parents and visitors to our institution.

We are committed to providing quality technical education and building the skilled workforce our state needs. Our faculty combines academic rigour with strong industry links, and our placement cell works throughout the year to connect final year students with employers.

Dr. R. K. Sharma, Principal
